<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$count</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">float</span> <span class="hl-var">$ratio</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$optCount</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">float</span> <span class="hl-var">$optRatio</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$ints</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$nums</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            count: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'count'</span>],
            ratio: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'ratio'</span>],
            optCount: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'optCount'</span>],
            optRatio: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'optRatio'</span>],
            ints: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'ints'</span>],
            nums: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'nums'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'count'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;count,
            <span class="hl-str">'ratio'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;ratio,
            <span class="hl-str">'optCount'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;optCount,
            <span class="hl-str">'optRatio'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;optRatio,
            <span class="hl-str">'ints'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;ints,
            <span class="hl-str">'nums'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;nums,
        ];
    }
}
